ingredients.name: Buttermilk
substitutes: milk with 1 tbsp lemon juice per 250 ml, rested 5 minutes

steps.title: Mix dry
steps.instruction: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.

steps.title: Mix wet
steps.instruction: Whisk buttermilk and eggs in a jug.

steps.title: Melt butter
steps.instruction: Melt the butter, then whisk it into the wet mix.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Pour wet into dry and stir until just combined; lumps are fine.

steps.title: Rest
steps.instruction: Let the batter rest while the pan heats.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Cook ladlefuls on medium heat; flip when bubbles pop.
